paperl10n-app-name: The app's name. Usually not translated.
paperl10n-open-folder: Button that shows the folder picker to open a project. The ellipsis means a dialog follows.
paperl10n-opening: Replaces {{msg-paperl10n|paperl10n-open-folder}} while a project is opening.
paperl10n-empty-state: Shown before any project is open.
paperl10n-interface-language: Label of the selector for the language of the app itself (not of the project).
paperl10n-project-format: Tooltip on the format name in the header's project chip. $1: the format plugin's name, e.g. "VitePress".
paperl10n-source-pane: Heading of the source pane. $1: the source language's own name, e.g. "English".
paperl10n-target-pane: Heading of the translation pane. $1: the target language's own name, e.g. "עברית".
paperl10n-documents-count: Number of source documents. $1: the number.
paperl10n-no-documents: Shown when the open project has no source documents.
paperl10n-config-warnings: Heading above a list of non-fatal notes about the project's config file (each note is shown in English for now).
paperl10n-error-workspace-folder-unavail: Error. $1: the reason code: not-found, not-a-folder, or unreadable.
paperl10n-error-workspace-config-missing: Error when the chosen folder has no config file. "paperl10n.config.json" is a file name: don't translate it.
paperl10n-error-workspace-config-unreada: Error. $1: the config file's path; $2: the problem code.
paperl10n-error-workspace-config-invalid: Heading above a list of problems in the config file (each problem is shown in English for now).
paperl10n-error-workspace-unknown-docume: Error. $1: the plugin id written in the config file.
paperl10n-error-workspace-no-document-fo: Error. "documentFormat" is a config key: don't translate it.
paperl10n-error-workspace-unknown-projec: Error when the app no longer knows the project the UI refers to.
paperl10n-error-formats-invalid-options: Error. $1: the plugin id; $2: the plugin's explanation (in English).
paperl10n-error-formats-unsupported-proj: Error. $1: the plugin id; $2: the plugin's explanation (in English).
paperl10n-error-formats-file-access: Error. $1: the plugin id; $2: the file's path; $3: the problem code.
paperl10n-error-formats-plugin-failed: Error when a plugin crashed (a bug in the plugin). $1: the plugin id; $2: technical details.
paperl10n-error-internal-unexpected: Error for a bug in the app itself.
paperl10n-error-internal-invalid-request: Error for a malformed request between the app's own parts (a bug).
paperl10n-theme: Accessible name of the group of theme choices (color scheme of the app).
paperl10n-theme-system: Theme choice: follow the operating system's light or dark setting. Shown as a tooltip and read by screen readers.
paperl10n-theme-light: Theme choice: always use the light color scheme.
paperl10n-theme-dark: Theme choice: always use the dark color scheme.
paperl10n-welcome-title: Title of the welcome screen, shown before any project is open.
paperl10n-language-pair: Read by screen readers for the language pair in the header (shown visually as "English → עברית"). $1: the source language's own name; $2: the target language's own name.
paperl10n-pages: Heading and accessible name of the sidebar that lists the project's pages (documents).
paperl10n-find-page: Accessible label of the search box that filters the list of pages.
paperl10n-find-page-placeholder: Placeholder text in the page search box: what you can search by.
paperl10n-pages-matching: Shown while searching pages. $1: the number of pages that match; $2: the number of pages in total.
paperl10n-no-matching-pages: Shown when no page matches the search. $1: what the user typed.
paperl10n-content-later: Note under the document panes: Paper Lion can't show page contents yet; those features come in later versions.
